blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte urged a trial chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) to reject the testimony and related evidence on the Davao Death Squad (DDS) of a key prosecution witness it called “deeply hostile” and “emotionally unstable.” The defense, led by Peter Haynes, told the ICC’s Trial Chamber (TC) III in a Nov. 12 filing released only this week that a prosecution witness identified only as “P-0002” had made “inconsistent” and contradicting statements in his testimony, describing all the evidence provided as “unreliable” and “lacks probative value.” Among the purported inconsistencies that P-0022, it said, […]...
